approach: Add a gate integration test file, crates/athena-gate/tests/bootstrap_requirement.rs, with two tests. (1) It reads docs/spec.toml (same slicing approach as crates/athena-core/tests/model_roster.rs:51-68) and requires the OLY-B-O1-01 entry to have a mechanism other than "none" that names `athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range`, owner = "Athena", and a measure ending `status: not shown`, naming the test. (2) It builds a throwaway git repository with `athena_git::Git::isolated` and `tempfile` (both already normal dependencies of athena-gate, so Cargo.toml stays unchanged), then calls the real `athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range`. It expects `Open` while records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json is absent and `ClosedThrough(<commit>)` once a commit adds that outcome. Then edit the OLY-B-O1-01 entry in docs/spec.toml to name the mechanism and a measure, and add a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] / Added in the style of the OLY-B-SET-02 entry. The doc comment on `bootstrap_range` in invariant.rs gets one line naming OLY-B-O1-01. No behavior changes. The existing in-source test `bootstrap_commits_pass_while_the_range_is_open_and_not_after` (invariant.rs:1102-1122) already shows the full gate accepting a bootstrap commit while the range is open and refusing one after it closes; the new range test is named with `bootstrap` so `cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap` runs both.

decisions.choice: Point the mechanism at the existing `athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range` (rule M6) and state in the measure that 'v0 stays small' is not mechanically enforced.
decisions.reason: The code is already there: invariant.rs:60-79 defines the range and invariant.rs:175-197 refuses `Athena-Job: bootstrap` after it closes. This is exactly what the request's 'recorded as such, the only work outside Athena' part needs. The user accepted this reading.

rejected.option: Add a size limit for v0
rejected.why: Out of scope. It would be a new rule with no defined threshold.

rejected.option: Add a new `athena status` label such as `status: bootstrap`
rejected.why: Out of scope. STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS would change, and the spec convention allows `status: not shown` plus a test.

decisions.choice: The new integration test calls only `bootstrap_range` through `athena_git::Git::isolated` and `tempfile`. It does not call `check` or `Judged`.
decisions.reason: The crate's test helpers (`repo`, `write`, `commit`, lib.rs:396-418) are under `#[cfg(test)]`, so an integration test cannot use them. The test needs only `git init`, one file write and one commit. This leaves Cargo.toml untouched. The full accept/refuse behavior stays covered by the existing in-source test, which `cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap` also runs.

rejected.option: Add a testkit dev-dependency to athena-gate/Cargo.toml
rejected.why: Not needed. The crate-reach facts list gate's dev crates as none, and Git::isolated is enough.

rejected.option: Move the new test into invariant.rs
rejected.why: The brief asks for a file under crates/athena-gate/tests/. Spec parsing there matches the model_roster.rs precedent.

decisions.choice: The measure reads like `... cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap (spec entry in crates/athena-gate/tests/bootstrap_requirement.rs); 'v0 stays small' is not enforced; status: not shown`.
decisions.reason: The xtask spec test (xtask/tests/spec.rs:194-213) requires only that the measure ends with `status: <label>`. `rsplit_once("status:")` takes the text after the last `status:`, so the text before the ending may not contain a second `status:`. `not shown` is the label the request allows when no `athena status` line shows the requirement.

files.purpose: At the OLY-B-O1-01 entry (line 2163), replace mechanism = "none" with a mechanism naming `athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range` (rule M6, accepts `Athena-Job: bootstrap` commits only until records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json closes the range), keep owner = "Athena", and write a measure that ends `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap` and the test file.

Two tests: the spec entry names a real mechanism, the Athena owner and a `status: not shown` measure; and `bootstrap_range` returns Open and then ClosedThrough in a throwaway repo (names contain `bootstrap`).
Add one doc-comment line on `bootstrap_range` (line 67) naming OLY-B-O1-01. No code change.
Add a first bullet under [Unreleased] / Added: OLY-B-O1-01 now has a mechanism, with the test names and the note that 'v0 stays small' stays prose and no commit is newly refused.

steps: Edit docs/spec.toml at OLY-B-O1-01 (line 2163): replace the mechanism line with text naming `athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range` (rule M6, Athena-Job: bootstrap accepted only until records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json closes the range); keep owner = "Athena"; set a single-line measure that names `cargo test -p athena-gate bootstrap`, says that 'v0 stays small' is not mechanically enforced, and ends with `status: not shown`. Do not touch the statement or source lines.

Create crates/athena-gate/tests/bootstrap_requirement.rs. Write `repo_file` as in model_roster.rs:11-16. Test 1 (`spec_entry_names_the_bootstrap_range_gate`): find `id = "OLY-B-O1-01"`, slice to the next `[[requirement]]`, assert no `mechanism = "none"`, assert it contains `athena_gate::invariant::bootstrap_range` and `owner = "Athena"`, take the `measure = ` line and assert it ends with `status: not shown` and names `bootstrap`. Test 2 (`bootstrap_range_is_open_then_closed_by_the_outcome_record`): make a tempdir, `Git::isolated(dir.path())`, `git init -q -b main`, write a file, `git add -A`, commit and take the head id; assert `bootstrap_range(&git, "HEAD")` is `BootstrapRange::Open`; write records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json (JSON copied from invariant.rs:1109, with `through_commit` set to that id), commit, and assert it is `BootstrapRange::ClosedThrough(id)`.
Add a one-line doc comment on `bootstrap_range` in crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs (line 67) naming OLY-B-O1-01 as the requirement it meets. Make no other code change.

Add a bullet at the top of CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] / Added, in the style of the OLY-B-SET-02 entry (CHANGELOG.md:26): OLY-B-O1-01 now has a mechanism, `bootstrap_range` in crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs (rule M6); the measure is `status: not shown` and names the test; 'v0 stays small' stays prose; the gate itself and the records are unchanged.

Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo test -p athena-gate`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` to check the xtask spec test and the boundary scan over the new text.

risks.risk: The measure parse breaks if the text contains `status:` twice or spans lines (xtask uses `rsplit_once("status:")`).
risks.mitigation: The spec-entry test slices the entry with the same `[[requirement]]` search model_roster.rs:57 uses and reads the `measure = ` line. The producer keeps the measure on one line and avoids a second `status:` inside it.

risks.risk: The temp-repo test depends on a git binary and identity settings in the checks' environment.
risks.mitigation: The test runs `git init -q -b main` and commits with `Git::isolated`, which sets author, committer and gpgsign=false, the same setup as the in-source helpers (gate/src/lib.rs:396-418).

risks.risk: The outcome JSON in the new test drifts from the `athena.outcome/1` schema, so `AnyRecord::parse` fails and the code silently reports `ClosedThrough("")`.
risks.mitigation: The outcome JSON is copied from the string in invariant.rs:1109, which the existing test already parses, and the test asserts `ClosedThrough` carries the commit id.

risks.risk: 'v0 stays small' is not enforced, so the requirement is only partly mechanised.
risks.mitigation: The measure says so in plain words and ends `status: not shown`; the changelog bullet repeats it. This matches the request's own allowed label.

risks.risk: The brief lists crates/athena-gate/Cargo.toml and invariant.rs as deliverables but the plan changes only a doc line and no Cargo.toml.
risks.mitigation: I only edit a doc comment and do not touch Cargo.toml; if the producer finds Cargo.toml must change, it keeps the change to one dependency line and reports why.

Fixture: a `tempfile::tempdir` plus `athena_git::Git::isolated` (git/src/lib.rs:179); the test runs `git init`, writes records/jobs/bootstrap/outcome.json and commits. The outcome JSON has the same fields as the string at invariant.rs:1109, with `through_commit` set to the first commit. The fixture is created inside the test, so no injection is needed. demonstrations.method: The filter `bootstrap` runs the existing in-source test `bootstrap_commits_pass_while_the_range_is_open_and_not_after` and the new range test (its name contains `bootstrap`).
demonstrations.observes: The first bootstrap commit and the closing commit pass the gate while the range is open. A late `Athena-Job: bootstrap` commit after the outcome names `through_commit` is refused with one violation. The new test sees `Open` then `ClosedThrough`.

If `bootstrap_range` ignored the outcome file, the new range test fails.
